description: No candidate agent is installed without explicit human approval. The hasApprovalForInstall check must pass before any installation proceeds.

preconditions.description: A candidate agent exists in 'presented-for-approval' or later status

expectedOutcome.description: Installation only proceeds when an ApprovalRecord with decision 'approve' exists for the candidate. processApprovalDecision with 'reject' or 'defer' never triggers installation.
